relationships.subject: LY2828360
relationships.evidence_quote: LY2828360 (10 mg/kg i.p.) reversed the maintenance of carrageenan-induced mechanical allodynia in female mice

relationships.subject: peripheral sensory neuron CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-allodynic efficacy of LY2828360 was absent in conditional KO (cKO) mice lacking CB2 receptors in peripheral sensory neurons
